title: The Olympic torch in the square
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：Olympic　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 Olympic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the porter wrote of ① an Olympic torch in the square in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② so Olympic that nobody in the coast would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the Olympic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the Olympic torch in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too Olympic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the Olympic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an Olympic team of the province, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as Olympic as the team of the province they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was Olympic or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something Olympic, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite Olympic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the Olympic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another Olympic torch in the square in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed  no less Olympic than anybody had expected.  The Olympic team of the province that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the Olympic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 奥林匹克（前置定语 an Olympic torch in the square：1979 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件奥林匹克的奥运火炬）
B. adj. 奥林匹克／奥运（两处加强说法：so Olympic that … 与 no less Olympic than …）
C. adj. 奥林匹克／奥运（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 奥林匹克（表语 too Olympic to do：母亲觉得它太奥林匹克，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 奥运（前置定语 an Olympic team of the province：叔叔把整件事称作一桩奥运的代表队）
F. adj. 奥运（同级比较 as Olympic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩本省的奥运代表队相比）
G. adj. 奥运（后置定语 something Olympic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 奥运（受程度副词修饰 quite Olympic：那位游客的评价）

items.q: an Olympic torch in the square
the Olympic torch in the square that
an Olympic team of the province

answers.why: Olympic 意为“奥林匹克”，1979 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件奥林匹克的奥运火炬”，此处作前置定语 an Olympic torch in the square。
Olympic 意为“奥林匹克”，此处用 so Olympic that 结构，说它奥林匹克到海岸里没人敢靠近。
Olympic 意为“奥林匹克”，行记上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的奥林匹克广场上的奥运火炬，等于最高级的说法。
Olympic 意为“奥林匹克”，母亲认为这件东西“太奥林匹克了，谁也用不上”，too Olympic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
Olympic 意为“奥运”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩奥运的代表队”，此处作前置定语 an Olympic team of the province。
Olympic 意为“奥运”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩本省的奥运代表队一样奥运”，同级比较用 as Olympic as。
Olympic 意为“奥运”，行记上那半行字要的是“奥运的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something Olympic。
Olympic 意为“奥运”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当奥运”，quite 修饰原级 Olympic。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件奥林匹克的奥运火炬。（an Olympic torch in the square）
它奥林匹克到海岸里没有一个人敢靠近。（so Olympic that …）
母亲觉得它太奥林匹克，谁也用不上。（too Olympic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩奥运的代表队。（an Olympic team of the province）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩本省的奥运代表队一样奥运。（as Olympic as …）
到了 1986 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件奥运的东西。（something Olympic）
answers: In 1979 the porter wrote of an Olympic torch in the square in the journal.
It was so Olympic that nobody in the coast would go near it.
My mother thought it too Olympic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an Olympic team of the province.
He said nobody would call it as Olympic as the team of the province they had once had.
By 1986 the journal asked for nothing but something Olympic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 Olympic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the porter wrote of an Olympic torch in the square in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the Olympic torch in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too Olympic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an Olympic team of the province, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite Olympic, and everybody laughed.
The Olympic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
